spans.s:
Hair.
2
A name of VARUṆ

A kind of perfume: see वाला.
4 The name of a demon.
5 A name of VIṢṆU.
f. (-शी)
1 A lock of hair on the crown of the head.
2 The indigo plant.
3 Indian spikenard.
E.
क्लिश to bind, अण् affix, and ल rejected; or क the head, and ईश to rule, affix अच्; again, क water or happiness, and ईश the lord or master.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Skilful in dressing hair, taking pains with it, &c.
E.
केश, and कन् aff.

m. (-पः)
A quantity of hair.
E.
केश hair, and कलाप in this compound implying quantity.

m. (-रः)
A sort of sugar cane.
E.
केश, and कार what makes.

m. (-टः)
A louse.
E.
केश, and कीट an insect.

m. (-र्ब्भः)
1 A braid of hair.
2 Varuṇa.
E.
केश, and गर्भ origin.

m. (-कः)
A braid or tress of hair.
E.
केश hair, and गर्ब्भक a chaplet.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pulled or seized by the hair.
E.
केश, and गृहीत seized.

m. (-हः)
Pulling the hair.
E.
केश, and ग्रह seizing; also केशग्रहणं.

n. (-घ्नं)
Morbid baldness, falling of the hair.
E.
केश the hair, and घ्न what destroys, from हन् to injure, affix टच्.

m. (-च्छित् or -च्छिद्)
A barber, a hair-dresser.
E.
केश the hair, छिद् to cut, affix क्विप्.

m. (-टः)
1 A name of VIṢṆ

A goat.
3 A louse.
5 A brother.
5 One of KĀMA'S arrows.
6 A tree, commonly Sonapat, (शोणक.)
E.
केश hair, अट to go, affix अच्, deriv. irr.

m. (-धृत्)
The root of sweet flag.
E.
केश hair, धृ to hold, affix, क्विप्; resembling hair.

m. (-क्षः)
Much or ornamented hair.
E.
केश hair, पक्ष quantity, in this compound.

f. (-ङ्क्तिः)
1 A row or line of hair.
2 A quantity of hair.
E.
केश, and पंक्ति a line.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Achyranthes aspera); also अपामार्ग.
E.
केश hair, पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-शः)
Much or ornamented hair.
f. (-शी)
A lock of hair on the top of the head.
E.
केश hair, पाश quantity, in this compound.

m. (-भूः)
The head.
E.
केश, and भू place.

m. (-कः)
A comb.
E.
केश hair, मृज to clean, ण्वुल् affix; also केशमार्जन.

n. (-नं)
1 A comb.
2 Cleaning the hair.
E.
see the preceding, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-ष्टिः)
1 A large species of Nimb tree.
2 A handful of hair.
E.
केश, and मुष्टि the fist.

mn. (-रः-रं)
The filament of a lotus or of any vegetable.
m. (-रः)
1 A plant, commonly Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.)
2 A tree bearing a white strong smelling flower, (Mimusops elengi): see वकुल.
3 A shrub used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria); also पुन्नाग.
4 A lion's mane.
n. (-रं)
Asafoetida.
E.
क water, &c. in the seventh case के, शृ to go, अप् affix; also with सृ to go केसर.

mn. (-रः-रं)
A filament.
m. (-रः)
1 A lion.
2 A horse.
3 The mane of a horse or lion, &c., see केशर.
4 A plant, (Mimusops elengi.)
5 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
nf. (-रं-री)
Asafoetida.
n. (-रं)
1

Gold.
2

Sulphate of iron.
3 The flower of the Nagesar.
E.
के on the head, सृ to go, ट aff.

m. (-नः)
A plant: see भृङ्गराज, (Verbesina prostrata).
E.
केश the hair, and रञ्जन what colours.

m. (-जः)
A species of Bhringariva: see the preceding.
E.
केश hair, राज to shine, टच् aff.

m. (-म्लः)
A citron tree.

m. (-म्लः)
A citron.
E.
केसर, and अम्ल sour.

m. (-री)
1 A lion.
2 A horse.
3 A plant used in dying: see पुन्नाग.
4 Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.)
5 The citron tree.
E.
केशर a mane, a filament, &c. इनि aff.

m. (-री)
1 A lion.
2 A horse.
3 A plant used in dying: see पुन्नाग.
4 Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea.)
5 A monkey the father of HANUMĀN.
E.
केसर a filament, a mane, इनि aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Having much or handsome hair.
m. (-वः)
1 A name of KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆ

A plant, commonly Punnag: see पुन्नाग.
E.
क BRAHMA, and ईश ŚIVA, व who goes, &c. from वा with ड affix; again केश hair, व who possesses; fine-haired.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a fine head of hair.
E.
केश and मतुप् aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
Devotion to KṚṢṆA.
E.
केशव, and भक्ति faith.

m. (-धः)
1 The mango tree.
2 Any weapon of KṚṢṆA.
E.
केशव KṚṢṆA, and आयुध a weapon.

m. (-यः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
केशव KṚṢṆA, and आलय abode.

m. (-लः)
See the preceding.

m. (-सः)
See the preceding.

m. (-शः)
A tress or fillet of hair.
E.
केश hair, and बेश ornament.

m. (-लः)
Much or ornamented hair.
E.
केश hair, and हल here implying much.

n. (-शि)
Pulling the hair mutually, hair to hair.
E.
केश hair, repeated, affix इञ्.

m. (-न्तः)
1 Cutting off the hair finally as a religious ceremony, performed upon Brahmans at sixteen years of age; Kṣatriyas at twenty-two; and Vaiśyas at twenty-four.
2 The tip or end of hair.
E.
केश, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Extending to the hair.
2 Relating to the ceremony of final tonsure.
E.
केशान्त, and ठक aff.

m. (-रिः)
A tree, (Mesua ferrea.)

n. (-णं)
Pulling the hair, especially amorously, playing with it, rubbing it, &c.
E.
केश the hair, अव implying improperly, and मर्षण rubbing.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Having fine or luxuriant hair.
2 Relating to the hair.
E.
केश hair, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Having fine hair.
m. (-शी)
1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆ
The name of a Daitya or demon killed by KṚṢṆ

A lion.
f. (-शिनी)
1 A kind of grass, (Andropogon aculeatum.)
2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.)
E.
केश hair, इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
केशि a demon, सूदन destroyer; also similar compounds, as केशिहन्, कशिनिसूदन, &c.

m. (-हा)
See the preceding.

m. (-यः)
Much or handsome hair.
E.
केश hair, उच्चय heap, abundance.

n. (-रं)
Saffron.
E.
केसर, and वर best.

m. (-तः)
The monkey HANUMAN.
E.
केसरि, and सुत son.
